onboardingWelcome.subject: Welcome to Coaching Studio
onboardingWelcome.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Welcome to Coaching Studio. Your account is now active and ready to use.

You can now sign in and begin exploring programs, events, and assessments.

Warm regards,
Team Coaching Studio

onboardingActivation.body:
Dear {{recipientName}},

Your Coaching Studio account has been provisioned for {{tenantName}}.

Please complete your profile after sign-in to activate all workflows.

Warm regards,
Team Coaching Studio

managedUserWelcome.body:
